sentences.en: We were granted the privilege of fishing in this bay.
sentences.zh: 我们被允许在这个海湾里钓鱼。

sentences.en: The river descends from the mountains to the bay below.
sentences.zh: 河水从山间流下，注入下面的海湾。

sentences.en: He kept the invaders at bay with a machine gun.
sentences.zh: 他用机枪把入侵者挡在了外面。

senses.zh: 湾，海湾，山脉中的凹处，红棕色，隔间，配电间犬吠，围困，月桂树，名望
吼叫着追赶或进攻，哀号把...围困住
